name: BfgsVerification.LReturnStableOrbit.source_positive_return_orbit
type:
∀ (μ : ℝ),
  ∀ V ∈ 𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed,
    ∃ w,
      (∀ (n : ℕ), w n ∈ V) ∧
        Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed) ∧
          0 < BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.scale (w 0) ∧
            ∀ (n : ℕ), w (n + 1) = BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ (w n)

name: BfgsVerification.LReturnStableOrbit.source_oracle_orbit
type:
∀ (μ c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
  0 < c₁ →
    c₁ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      0 < c₂ →
        ∀ V ∈ 𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed,
          ∃ w,
            (∀ (n : ℕ), w n ∈ V) ∧
              Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed) ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.scale (w n)) ∧
                  (∀ (n : ℕ), BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.Conditions μ c₁ c₂ (w n)) ∧
                    ∀ (n : ℕ), w (n + 1) = BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ (w n)

name: BfgsVerification.LReturnStableGraph.source_splitting
type:
∀ (μ : ℝ),
  ∃ E,
    (∀ (z : BfgsVerification.LBlockSplitting.Coordinates), E z 4 = z.1 1) ∧
      ∃ A L,
        ‖A‖ < 1 ∧
          ‖↑L.symm‖ < 1 ∧
            (fderiv ℝ (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed).comp
                ↑E =
              (↑E).comp (A.prodMap ↑L)

name: BfgsVerification.LReturnStableGraph.source_smooth_stable_graph
type:
∀ (μ : ℝ),
  ∀ W ∈ 𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed,
    ∃ E,
      (∀ (z : BfgsVerification.LBlockSplitting.Coordinates), E z 4 = z.1 1) ∧
        ∃ A L,
          ‖A‖ < 1 ∧
            ‖↑L.symm‖ < 1 ∧
              (fderiv ℝ (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed).comp
                    ↑E =
                  (↑E).comp (A.prodMap ↑L) ∧
                ∃ h V,
                  IsOpen V ∧
                    0 ∈ V ∧
                      h 0 = 0 ∧
                        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h V ∧
                          HasFDerivAt h 0 0 ∧
                            ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
                                (BfgsVerification.AnalyticStableGraph.chart BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed E h)
                                V ∧
                              HasFDerivAt
                                  (BfgsVerification.AnalyticStableGraph.chart BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed E
                                    h)
                                  ((↑E).comp
                                    (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ (BfgsVerification.Vec 2) (BfgsVerification.Vec 3)))
                                  0 ∧
                                (∀ (a : BfgsVerification.Vec 2),
                                    BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.scale
                                        (BfgsVerification.AnalyticStableGraph.chart
                                          BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed E h a) =
                                      a 1) ∧
                                  ∀ a ∈ V,
                                    ∃ w,
                                      w 0 =
                                          BfgsVerification.AnalyticStableGraph.chart
                                            BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed E h a ∧
                                        (∀ (n : ℕ), w n ∈ W) ∧
                                          Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed) ∧
                                            ∀ (n : ℕ), w (n + 1) = BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ (w n)

name: BfgsVerification.LGlobalFailure.actual_orbit_data
type:
∀ (μ c₁ c₂ : ℝ),
  0 < c₁ →
    c₁ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      0 < c₂ →
        ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 0,
          ∃ D,
            Tendsto D.state atTop (𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed) ∧
              (∀ (k : ℕ), D.x k ∈ U) ∧
                ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : Fin 9),
                  BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q = BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k →
                    D.x k + BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength q • BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (D.H k) (D.g k) 1 ∈ U

name: BfgsVerification.LSeedCopies.data_spec
type:
Tendsto BfgsVerification.LSeedCopies.data.state atTop (𝓝 BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed) ∧
  (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.LSeedCopies.data.x k ∈ BfgsVerification.LEmbedding.localDomain) ∧
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (q : Fin 9),
      BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q = BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.phase k →
        BfgsVerification.LSeedCopies.data.x k +
            BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength q •
              BfgsVerification.bfgsStep (BfgsVerification.LSeedCopies.data.H k) (BfgsVerification.LSeedCopies.data.g k)
                1 ∈
          BfgsVerification.LEmbedding.localDomain

name: BfgsVerification.LWhitening.failureFamily
type:
{F : BfgsVerification.Vec 2 → ℝ} →
  BfgsVerification.LActualCopies.CopyData F →
    ℕ →
      BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun 2
        (BfgsVerification.AffineWhitening.objective BfgsVerification.LWhitening.coordinateMatrix F)

name: BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.actual_coordinateGradient
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} {x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
  HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x → BfgsVerification.coordinateGradient F x = g

name: BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.Conditions.physical_reject
type:
∀ {μ c₁ c₂ : ℝ} {w : BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.State},
  BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.Conditions μ c₁ c₂ w →
    0 < BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.scale w →
      ∀ (q : Fin 9),
        BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialAccept q = false →
          ¬BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo (BfgsVerification.LQuadraticSeed.objective μ)
              (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.physicalPoint μ w (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q))
              (BfgsVerification.bfgsStep
                (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.physicalMetric μ w (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q))
                (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.phaseGradient μ w (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q)) 1)
              (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedOracle.phaseGradient μ w (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialPhase q)) c₁
              (BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.trialLength q)
